theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by

  have hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  have hk := UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  have := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this hn (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  have := UpdateStatesLength hu

  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate this (updatedStatesDefMonotone hk)
  simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
  intro x hx hx'
  cases hn x hx' ▸ hk x hx

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hr, he⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds hp))
  have hz := hg _ ((IsTestFunction.mk hd hk).smul_right (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact ((hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (fun x => by
      by_cases hx : φ x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      · exact mul_nonneg (hr (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hs (subset_closure hx)))
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one he) hp.ne')).ne' hz

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb j : ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA3 (j, i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out)]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    rw [← Finset.sum_apply, ← FunLike.coe_sum, ← fderiv_fun_sum
      (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [1, 2, y]
      change (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) y
      rw [((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    rw [fderiv_const_mul
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, one_div]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  have hsum := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hsum.const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hsum.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_inv_rev,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  have lift (f g : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra →ₗ[ℂ] 𝓕.WickAlgebra)
      (h : ∀ l, f (ofCrAnListFBasis l) = g (ofCrAnListFBasis l)) (x) : f x = g x :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext h) x
  apply lift (T.comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (a * C)))
    ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp
    (T.comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ a)))
  intro φs
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, T, C]
  apply lift (T.comp ((LinearMap.mulRight ℂ
    (ofCrAnListF φs)).comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C)))
    ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp
    (T.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ (ofCrAnListF φs))))
  intro φs'
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulRight_apply,
    ofListBasis_eq_ofList, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, T, C]
  let S := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
  let E := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let X := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    S)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs'))
  let Y := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter E φs)) *
    ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    S))
  have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, E c) :
      ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
      X * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * Y := by
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, E, S, mul_assoc]
  have pair : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
      𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) =
      ι C := by
    simp [C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append]
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (X * ι C * Y) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
          map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
          List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      have s1 := split [φ, ψ] (by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl])
      have s2 := split [ψ, φ] (by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl])
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at s1 s2
      simp only [map_smul]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2, ← pair]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      have hXY := split [] (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at hXY
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hXY]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_not.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
    specialize iha ha'
    specialize ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, iha.choose_spec.1.par ihb.choose_spec.1, iha.choose_spec.2.par ihb.choose_spec.2⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case par.red_I hb ihb ha iha | red_I.par ha hb =>
    cases ha
    exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
  case par.red_K ha ih | red_K.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    use x, hx, ParallelReduction.red_K ..
  case par.red_S hb ihb a c ha iha | red_S.par ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, (hx.par hb).par (hy.par hb), .red_S ..⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}

    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)

    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t

  have hb j := Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ hA3 (j, i)) t x
  have hs j := Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i)
  have hc j := Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out), hs, hc] at hb
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by

      (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
    conv_lhs =>

      change (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) y
      rw [((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    rw [fderiv_const_mul
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        hJ1 t).differentiableAt]

  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)

  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    hJ1 x i
  have hsum := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hsum.const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hsum.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.2⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  haveI : Nonempty C := ⟨0⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, _, hd⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem ((Set.image_nonempty (f :=
    fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard)).mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [show d = _ from hd.symm]
    let H := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g x)
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
    let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, i.2.trans ((Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡).trans_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps)
    change H.card ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ←Fintype.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ←Finset.card_univ (α := Fin (2 ^ steps)), ←Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => Q p.1 p.2)
    intro x hx
    let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
    refine ⟨(y, _), ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc := by
    have hf : 2 * d ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1 :=
      Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
    have he : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
        BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc - 1 := by
      dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance]
      rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
        Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
        Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
    have hh := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      (by simpa only [←mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hf)
    rw [he] at hh
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_pred (Nat.succ_pos _) hh
  unfold hammingClose
  have hc := Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hg
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' hc 2).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hn)
